interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked, high-visibility crosswalks to provide designated and safer crossing points for residents.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to manage vehicle speeds along this long, straight residential stretch.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone with street trees to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Paint clear lane markings to define travel lanes and potentially narrow them to encourage slower speeds.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a continental or ladder-style marked crosswalk to clearly define the pedestrian path and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crossing point to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming elements like speed humps to ensure vehicle speeds remain appropriate for a residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface and level the concrete walkway to eliminate tripping hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to intersections or driveways to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If the block is long, a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage would provide a safer, designated point for residents to cross.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Management
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures such as speed humps or narrowed lanes to reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with High-Visibility Markings
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand warrants, install a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage to provide a safe legal crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the existing sidewalk to provide a smooth, accessible, and hazard-free walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and personal security for people walking at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide shade, improve the aesthetic environment, and act as a vertical element to naturally slow traffic.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Introduce speed humps or cushions to physically enforce lower vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add a furniture or planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
